scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
groups: selected top-32 by final W2_K2 reward

reading_rules.SELECTED: tops - ancestors sign-flip below p05 AND tops - drift relabel below p05
reading_rules.INHERITED: tops - ancestors inside its band (robustness was already in the walkers)
reading_rules.DRIFT_ASSOCIATED: tops - ancestors below p05 AND drift - ancestors below p05 AND tops - drift inside band
reading_rules.NONE: otherwise; a length covariate regression is reported alongside

material_rule: any paired or relabelled contrast outside its band, or the reading is not NONE
